title: Irish Frittata Keto Recipe
description: A keto version of the traditional Irish frittata, made with eggs, vegetables, and a hint of spice. Perfect for a low-carb breakfast or brunch.
instructions: Cook the bacon in a large skillet over medium heat until crispy.
Remove the bacon from the skillet, leaving the grease behind.
Add the diced onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the sliced cucumber and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs and a pinch of salt.
Pour the egg mixture over the vegetables in the skillet.
Cook the eggs until the edges start to set, about 2-3 minutes.
Sprinkle the shredded cheddar cheese over the top of the eggs.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the eggs are set and the cheese is melted.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Cut the frittata into wedges and serve hot.
